metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1982 · Gandhi
metas.description: The life of the lawyer who became the famed leader of the Indian revolts against the British rule through his philosophy of nonviolent protest.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1980 · Kagemusha: The Shadow Warrior
metas.description: A petty thief with an utter resemblance to a samurai warlord is hired as the lord's double. When the warlord later dies the thief is forced to take up arms in his place.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1989 · Glory
metas.description: Robert Gould Shaw leads the U.S. Civil War's first all-black volunteer company, fighting prejudices from both his own Union Army, and the Confederates.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1984 · The Killing Fields
metas.description: A journalist is trapped in Cambodia during Pol Pot's bloody Year Zero cleansing campaign.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1987 · The Last Emperor
metas.description: Bernardo Bertolucci's Oscar-winning dramatization of China's eleventh and final monarch of the Qing dynasty: Emperor Puyi.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1986 · The Mission
metas.description: Eighteenth-century Spanish Jesuits try to protect a remote South American tribe in danger of falling under the rule of pro-slavery Portugal.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1981 · Gallipoli
metas.description: Two Australian sprinters face the brutal realities of war when they are sent to fight in the Gallipoli campaign in Turkey during World War I.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1989 · Henry V
metas.description: In the midst of the Hundred Years War, the young King Henry V of England embarks on the conquest of France in 1415.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1981 · Reds
metas.description: A radical American journalist becomes involved with the Communist revolution in Russia, and hopes to bring its spirit and idealism to the United States.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1986 · Salvador
metas.description: A burnt-out photojournalist becomes involved in a Central American revolution.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1984 · The Bounty
metas.description: Fed up with their Captain's harsh discipline, a sailing ship's crew decides to take action.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1983 · Silkwood
metas.description: A worker at a plutonium processing plant is purposefully contaminated, psychologically tortured and possibly murdered to prevent her from exposing worker safety violations at the plant.
